A cell whose ptrace reference left no usable golden log is outside it and is counted apart.

in the population, scored 0: kvm verify is disabled: Needs the rest of package K item 2b (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/5063). Slice 2b-1 serves another process's /proc/<pid> directory, stat and comm, so ps lists every guest process (host procps 3.3.17), and slice 2b-2 renders every process's status, and slice 2b-3 serves every process's cmdline and environ, which the pinned root's procps 4.0.6 also reads (measured with that procps at slice 2b-3: ps lists every guest process on KVM at L2); but /proc/1/stat, the namespace init's (Hermit's own process, not a guest), is still EACCES on KVM, so ps leaves out the row ptrace shows for pid 1. The O_PATH /proc/self EACCES once named here (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/5039) is gone since slice K10.
